name: GranularSynth
brief: Granular synthesis engine with up to 32 simultaneous grains.
description:
Captures incoming audio into a buffer and replays it as overlapping
grains with configurable size, density, position, and pitch. Includes
a custom waveform inspector showing the capture buffer and active
grain positions.
tips: Freeze a texture by setting position manually and disconnecting input.

params.name: position
params.doc: Playback position in the capture buffer (0-1).

params.name: randomize
params.doc: Random scatter applied to grain position, pitch, and timing.

params.name: window
params.doc: Grain envelope shape. Hann is smooth, Triangle is percussive.
